action_tie_rule: smallest legal ID within tolerance of actual legal maximum
feature_zero_definition: completed ant tour evaluations per colony / evaluation limit per colony; computed before the next full batch
evaluation_unit: one completed ant candidate after construction and checklist LS; excludes internal LS move checks and common initialization
batch_limit_policy: evaluation limit is a nonnegative multiple of ants; at most UINT32_MAX complete batches
legacy_policy: feature_spec_id 1 requires wall-clock entrypoint; feature_spec_id 2 requires count entrypoint
